blocks.alt: Compare the Path Length to Reach Adjacent Vertices of C

blocks.content: In the graph, all the remaining vertices are connected to vertex C. So, we can update all the remaining distances from vertex C instead of vertex A.

items: If we can reach a vertex from C, we can reach it from A.
